title: Persist workspace preferences per member
acceptance:
**Story or goal** · Restore my settings after restarting the local client.

**Expected behaviour** · Derive the member ID from the selected server’s verified profile. Validate allowed values and atomically save theme, surface, density, motion and cursor in the current Windows user’s application-data directory. Load system defaults before connection.

**Scope boundary** · Client-host preferences only. Keep tokens in memory and exclude secrets from disk.

**Previous in delivery queue** · WI-035

**Depends on** · WI-026, WI-028

**Verify** · Apply distinct choices for two members, restart on a different port and reconnect to each. Exercise missing preferences, invalid values and failed writes without losing the last saved state.

**Effort basis** · Identity, durable data and failure recovery.
evidence: Alice and Blair saved distinct theme, surface, density, motion and cursor choices keyed by member id. The client host was stopped and relaunched on different ports; each member recovered their own settings and home. A member with no entry received the recorded defaults. Invalid values return 400 and leave the file untouched; a read-only file makes the save fail while the last good file stays. Evidence: qa/sprint-4/WI-036/.
